definition: כְּתֹ֫בֶת noun feminine only construct וּכְתֹבֶת קַעֲקַע לֹא תִתְּנוּ בָּכֶם Lev 19:28 i.e. a writing (mark or sign) of imprintment , scriptio stigmatis, perhaps of tattooing, compare Di (see also Ba NB 61 ).
